constraints.description: Production change is confined to src/app_int/main.py: add a single new top-level function `subtract`. No other file under src/ is modified (in particular src/app_int/__init__.py is unchanged). Traces to R1 and BA out-of-scope list.

Signature must be exactly two plain positional-or-keyword parameters named `a` then `b`, annotated `int`, with return annotation `int`; no defaults, no *args/**kwargs, no `/` or `*` markers. Traces to AC-2, AC-5.
Return value must be `a - b` (first argument minus second) with no special-casing of zero or negative inputs and no input validation or type coercion. Traces to AC-3, AC-4, BA assumption A1.
`subtract` must have a non-empty docstring in the same single-line style as `add`. Traces to AC-6.
Existing functions `health_check` and `add` and existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` must not be modified, renamed, or removed. Traces to AC-8.
pyproject.toml must not change; in particular the runtime `dependencies` list stays empty and no new imports of third-party packages are added to src/. Traces to AC-10.

Role write scopes: the Developer edits only src/** and must not create or edit test files; the test(s) for `subtract` (AC-7) are added by QA under tests/**, preferably in tests/test_main.py with imports kept in ruff/isort order. Traces to AC-7 and the DEVELOPMENT/QA role write_scope configuration.
`uv run pytest -q` and `uv run ruff check .` must both exit 0 after each role's change (ruff config: line-length 100, rules E, F, I, UP, B). Traces to AC-9.
